result:
Both gates are green.

**Summary:** The working tree had staged changes that reverted an already-merged fix (commit `4adadf0e0`, PR #3768) — the exact fix this task asked for: `ExecRunner.Run` bounded with an internal `execRunnerTimeout` (5 min default) via `context.WithTimeout`/`exec.CommandContext`, returning a `"timed out after ..."` error on deadline without touching the `CommandRunner` interface or call sites, plus `TestExecRunnerDeadline` covering both the stuck-command-times-out and fast-path-unchanged cases. I restored those two files to HEAD instead of re-authoring identical code. `go vet` and `go test` on `internal/agent/...` both pass. Working tree is clean — nothing to commit or push.
